designDecisions: INTERACTION ONLY (Max fork 1): storms distort the band field around them + shed a downstream wake INTO the bands. NO multi-deck parallax layering this increment (deferred; different machinery).

REAL DIRECTIONAL ADVECTION (pre-ruled): the viscous read stretches/folds the band pattern ALONG the local jet/shear direction — anisotropic displacement + roll-up at shear interfaces. NOT an amplitude bump on the existing isotropic edge noise (that is what Max read as 'not rendered at all').
STATIC PLACE-ONCE (program rule, non-negotiable): no uTime in any storm/band term; the viscous look is a baked/analytic still that reads fluid, not a running sim. Alea-only randomness.

PER-BAND JAGGEDNESS (Max fork 2): each band's edge roughness scales with that band's shear (belts rougher than zones on the same planet) + one per-seed global roughness draw. New scalars are D-slot-backed or declared-frozen-with-named-deriver per AC-0.
ONE INCREMENT, THREE SLICES (Max fork 3): interaction / ink-in-water / jaggedness share the zonalBandCol path + shear/mask fields; re-scope gate if any slice balloons.
OVERSHOOT BOLD (Max fork 4): ship a clearly-visible fluid read; Max dials back at UAT.

CORE MECHANISM ROUTED TO BUILD-PLAN: how the storm swirl deflects the BAKED wBand at render time (#3a's bake defeated the old deflection — the sticker-gap root cause). The baked aBand attribute and GOLDEN_BANDFIELD_HASH never change; render-side re-warp only. Whether a CPU-side mirror term is needed for headless asserts = build-plan call.

NEW FIELDS ARE ADDITIVE: any flow-direction/roughness attribute is a NEW baked attribute; aStorm mask + phase bank stay byte-identical (their goldens must not move); #4/#5 noted as optional future readers of the new field.
